messages:
Avery L: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — short owners + deadlines for the streaming silence/partial issue.

Chen W: Short summary?

Avery L: ~1.7% streams hit a >3s silence; ~0.4% returned partials. Spike overlapped with eviction job.

Diego M: Traces look like eviction occasionally preempts the flush loop for 50-300ms, clients then reconnect.

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-712 created. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/stream-silence (tags: partial, reconnect)

Avery L: Proposed quick actions: 1) SDK resume-dedupe + backoff defaults (owner: Chen) 2) synthetic heartbeat + alert (owner: Diego) 3) kv_eviction_atomic toggle + metric (owner: Avery).

Chen W: I'll draft SDK defaults and make resume-dedupe opt-in for one release. Due 2026-03-27. Suggested defaults: {"resumeDedupeMs":2000, "maxRetries":3}.

Diego M: I'll add a 45s synthetic stream asserting no gap >2.5s; metric telemetry.streaming.silence_pct. Target staging by 2026-03-28.

Avery L: I'll add kv_eviction_atomic toggle, emit eviction.lock_ms, and run canary. PR target 2026-03-25, canary 2026-03-31. Rollback: flip toggle=false.

ops-bot: Follow-up meeting scheduled 2026-04-01 10:00 UTC.

Chen W: Will post SDK PR link here when ready.

Diego M: Synthetic running in dev, will promote to staging after one clean run.

Avery L: Adding all items to INC-2026-712 and the reliability board. Please post brief updates here. Closing for now unless blockers arise.
